errors.evidence: The description omits the tick mark interval for the y-axis. The prompt requires stating the "tick label interval if numeric and regularly spaced", and the y-axis has tick marks at an interval of 2 (10, 12, 14, etc.).

The description states that the starting data points for the lines are at γ = 0.86. However, the plot shows the first data point for all three lines is located slightly to the left of the 0.86 tick mark, at approximately γ = 0.855. This incorrect x-coordinate is stated for all three series.
